Mark Webber's Formula 1 teammates who went on to win a drivers' championship in 2000-2025: only **Sebastian Vettel**.

Webber drove alongside several drivers at Jaguar, Williams, Red Bull and others, and none of them won the F1 title except Vettel. Vettel was his Red Bull teammate from 2009 (and for part of 2008), and Vettel won the drivers' championship in 2010, 2011, 2012 and 2013. The searches confirmed the 2009-2011 Red Bull pairing. I did not retrieve results on the other teammates' records, so I'm relying on my own knowledge for the claim that none of them won an F1 title.

The search results did not cover sports car racing. From my own knowledge, not the retrieved material, Webber also won the 2015 WEC drivers' championship with Porsche alongside Timo Bernhard and Brendon Hartley. If a non-F1 championship counts, those two would also qualify.

ANSWER: Sebastian Vettel
